items.title: Salesforce’s Agentforce Coworker Usage Soars 21x in Three Months as Enterprises Delegate Real Work to AI
items.summary: More than 185,000 users are putting Coworker to work, with companies including The Adecco Group, Fulton Bank, and BACA Systems expanding adoption across their businesses.

items.title: Complete Guide to Salesforce Go: The Future of Salesforce Setup
items.summary: One of the greatest things about Dreamforce’s coverage on Salesforce+ was the ability to get hands-on with some of the new features from almost anywhere in the world.

items.title: 10 Mistakes Salesforce Architects Make When Scaling Flow
items.summary: Flow is the go-to automation tool in most Salesforce orgs, and for good reason. It can handle a huge range of business processes without requiring developers to write Apex for every little thing.

items.title: Double recall: Inside the Agentforce Memory update
items.summary: Salesforce AI Research doubled Agentforce memory performance by creating a framework that tracks what an AI agent remembers.

items.title: ServiceNow Lays Off More Staff After Q3 Earnings Fail to Impress Wall Street
items.summary: ServiceNow has laid off more employees in its third round of cuts this year, reportedly affecting roles across the UK, the US, and India. The specific number of layoffs has not been confirmed.

items.title: HubSpot's 'suck it and see' approach to AI adoption - a work in progress, but worth the headwinds?
items.summary: HubSpot has rolled out a long game gambit around encouraging AI adoption, but the early signs look promising, says CEO Yamini Rangan.

items.title: The ASUG Tech Connect review - vendors had their AI moment. Now SAP customers have their say.
items.summary: Something was different at this year's ASUG Tech Connect. SAP customers have shifted. They aren't in some kind of magical agentic future, but they have a direction of travel.

items.title: Snowflake CoCo for Excel and Google Sheets: Governed AI
items.summary: Snowflake CoCo brings governed AI to Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, with live Snowflake data, agentic workbook building and role-based security.

items.title: Oracle rethinks the lakehouse as AI agents become data consumers

items.title: Agentic analytics require proper business context. Providing it has gotten easier with time

items.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
items.summary: OpenAI President Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.

items.title: Oracle wants to pull stalled AI agents out of demo mode and into production
items.summary: Companies want AI agents faster than they can build the AI architecture to run them. Most can put together a convincing demo.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire developer tooling startup Pierre Computer
items.summary: OpenAI Group PBC today announced plans to acquire Pierre Computer Company Inc., a low-profile developer tooling startup. The terms of the deal were not disclosed.
